metadata.description: Brandon's Claude Code plugins — autonomous project agents and execution helpers.

plugins.name: autonomous-project-agent
plugins.description: End-to-end project agent: classifies, researches, plans, and ships projects through gated phases with audits, a five-layer authentication security gate, an autopilot mode for unattended runs, an append-only error-mitigation loop that learns from past failures, autonomous Firebase CLI bootstrap, local-only Anthropic API key auto-discovery, and multi-agent orchestration capped by a diminishing-returns heuristic.
